SELECT ad.admin_dong_id AS adminDongId, sm.safety_score AS safetyScore, CASE WHEN ad.dong_population > 0 THEN ROUND(sm.cctv_count / (ad.dong_population / 1000), 2) ELSE NULL END AS cctvPer1000, latest_crime.crime_rate AS crimeRate, hm.hospital_count AS hospitalCount, lcm.department_store_count AS departmentStoreCount, lcm.mart_count AS martCount, gym.gym_count AS gymCount, park.park_count AS parkCount, conv.convenience_store_count AS convenienceStoreCount FROM admin_dongs ad LEFT JOIN safety_metrics sm ON sm.safety_id = ( SELECT MAX(safety_id) FROM safety_metrics WHERE admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id ) LEFT JOIN healthcare_metrics hm ON hm.healthcare_id = ( SELECT MAX(healthcare_id) FROM healthcare_metrics WHERE admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id ) LEFT JOIN life_convenience_metrics lcm ON lcm.convenience_id = ( SELECT MAX(convenience_id) FROM life_convenience_metrics WHERE admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gcs.gu_code, gcs.crime_rate FROM gu_crime_stats gcs JOIN ( SELECT gu_code, MAX(gu_crime_id) AS latest_gu_crime_id FROM gu_crime_stats GROUP BY gu_code ) latest ON latest.gu_code = gcs.gu_code AND latest.latest_gu_crime_id = gcs.gu_crime_id ) latest_crime ON latest_crime.gu_code = ad.gu_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT admin_dong_id, COUNT(*) AS convenience_store_count FROM places WHERE category = 'CONVENIENCE_STORE' GROUP BY admin_dong_id ) conv ON conv.admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT admin_dong_id, COUNT(*) AS gym_count FROM places WHERE category = 'GYM' GROUP BY admin_dong_id ) gym ON gym.admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT admin_dong_id, COUNT(*) AS park_count FROM places WHERE category = 'PARK' GROUP BY admin_dong_id ) park ON park.admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id WHERE ad.admin_dong_id IN
#{adminDongId}
